Privacy in this preview

Your information,
kept in your hands.

This concept has no analytics, advertising trackers or live contact-form submissions.

Saved homes

Saved sample property IDs are stored only in your browser’s local storage. Clear them using the button below or your browser settings.

Enquiry drafts

The contact form creates a draft within your browser. Nothing is sent to Samantha or a third-party CRM. Copying and downloading happen only when you choose those controls. Form fields are not deliberately persisted by the website.

Hosting and external links

The hosting service may process routine technical requests required to serve these pages. External websites have their own privacy practices. Before a live launch, this notice must be updated for the actual hosting, brokerage, forms and analytics in use.
